messages:
Priya: FYI I'm pulling together the QBR for NovaTech (Wed 9am ET). Need renewal ask, onboarding health, and two enablement options. Draft slides: https://drive.internal/novatech/qbr - can folks own parts? :spiral_calendar:
Liam: I'll do the utilization + seats growth chart. Prefer weekly view for the last 12 weeks.
Nora: I'll draft the renewal ask language + proposed 1-year commitment tiers. Want to align on non-negotiables.
Elliot: Health update: overall green but integration errors spike for new tenants. Linked ticket: SUP-3132. ShortTERM fix = retry backoff change; longer = SDK patch.
Ally: I'll compile customer feedback & training follow-ups. I have two quotes from the onboarding survey we can use.
Priya: Nice. Also include churn triggers from support and any exec concerns. VP-Account, can you confirm whether we want to propose a co-sell pilot?
VP-Account: Co-sell pilot is ok if they sign a 12mo ARR commitment. Send me the economic slide.
Nora: Noted. I'll include two pricing scenarios + required SLAs. ETA for my slide: Thu EOD.
Liam: Quick sample from prod logs for the integration errors: ```2026-03-10T14:23:11Z ERROR integration user_id=7823 code=ECONNRESET retry=1```
Elliot: Thanks. I'll attach the incident timeline and estimated ETA for SDK release (2 weeks) to a backup slide.
ops-bot: Rehearsal slots open: 2026-04-12 16:00 ET (recording enabled). Use /reserve to claim.
Priya: Action list: 1) Nora - renewal ask + concessions; 2) Liam - usage charts + ARR bridge; 3) Ally - quotes + training calendar; 4) Elliot - incident timeline + mitigation; 5) Priya - speaker notes + final deck. Deadline: Fri 12pm ET.
Ally: ack. I'll anonymize quotes: "Docs were great but we hit a snag on API tokens." Will propose a live training on 4/20.
Nora: Also flag renewal risk: top-2 concerns are onboarding friction and lack of analytics dashboard. Recommend a short-term dashboard demo in the QBR.
Liam: Growth numbers: seats +8% q/q, active seats plateaued last month. I'll highlight correlation with feature rollout Y.
Elliot: Suggest backup slide with mean time to recovery (MTTR) and SLA compliance in case execs ask ops questions.
Priya: Good call. ops-bot please book the rehearsal for 2026-04-12 16:00 ET and grant edit access to the deck to this thread.
ops-bot: Booked rehearsal: NovaTech QBR 2026-04-12 16:00 ET (60m). Deck permissions updated to include Priya, Liam, Nora, Elliot, Ally. Recording enabled.
support-bot: Alert: 3 open tickets in last 30 days tagged "onboarding"; avg response 6h. See support.internal/novatech/tickets
Priya: We'll show a remediation timeline (7/14 days) and the 30/60/90 enablement plan. If anyone adds slides after Fri 12pm ET ping me.
VP-Account: Please add any exec-level wins (customer ROI example) to start the deck. Short case study will help the ask.
Ally: I have a one-paragraph ROI snapshot we can add: 22% reduction in processing time for sample cohort. I'll drop it in.
Nora: Final asks for me by Thu noon so I can sync with VP-Account on concession wording.
Priya: Thanks team. Goal: final deck by Fri noon ET, rehearsal Mon 4/12 16:00 ET. If you can't make rehearsal, upload notes & speaker bullets. :thumbsup:
